Ran PyInstaller against the spec on Linux; datas collection stage passed, alembic tree + alembic.ini were packaged, and the full freeze produced /tmp/pyi_dist/roofspan-backend. rca of the issue: Spec had a stale datas entry referencing backend/migrations which never existed in this repo (Alembic dir is backend/alembic). PyInstaller's Analysis stage validates datas paths OS-independently, so the missing path caused build abort on Windows. Fix: changed the datas tuple to (BACKEND,'alembic')->'alembic'. Verified by static grep + successful PyInstaller run with alembic tree collected in Analysis-00.toc.
